result.judge_notes: pass 1 (A=without, B=with): Both answers merge the button variants and TextInput correctly, and both propose a sound Card split. A is more careful: it explains why Tag and StatusPill should stay separate, and it has no factual slips. B has the better table and adds kiosk-specific points, but it merges Tag and StatusPill despite their different meanings, leaves a placeholder ('[count from your repo]') in the answer, and claims 29 components when the list has 25. | pass 2 (A=with, B=without): Both answers merge the button variants and TextInput correctly, split Card into a plain container plus ProductCard and RefillCard, and are well organized. B keeps Tag and StatusPill separate and explains why, mentions the 62 and 35 files to migrate, and offers to check the repo. A has a leftover placeholder ('[count from your repo]') and miscounts the list (it says 29 components; there are 22). B's one slip is listing Card as 'removed' when Card actually stays as a smaller component.
